ROU.pitSystem: 10% Flat Rate across employment, freelance, rental & investment income
ROU.employeeSocialBreakdown: CAS (Pension): 25% + CASS (Health): 10% (Total 35% employee social deductions; ~41.5% employee deduction / ~42.8% total tax wedge incl. CAM)
ROU.employerPayrollBreakdown: CAM (Work Insurance Contribution): 2.25% paid by employer on gross salary
ROU.vatReduced: 9% (food, medicines, hospitality/HoReCa, solar panels) • 5% (books, cultural events, firewood/heating)
ROU.dividendNotes: 10% Dividend Withholding Tax + CASS (10% health insurance capped at 6, 12, or 24 minimum gross wages if annual dividends exceed thresholds)
ROU.capitalGainsRate: 1% (>1 yr) / 3% (<1 yr) via Romanian broker, or 10% via foreign broker + CASS thresholds; 10% on Crypto gains
ROU.propertyTax: 0.08% – 0.2% residential building tax; 0.2% – 1.3% commercial property tax

entities.name: PFA — Sistem Real (Persoană Fizică Autorizată)
entities.summary: 10% Income Tax on Net Profit (Gross Revenue minus deductible expenses & CAS/CASS). CAS (25% pension) is CAPPED at 12 or 24 minimum wages! CASS (10% health) is proportional between 6 and 60 minimum wages. Instant access to personal cash with 0% dividend tax.
entities.bestFor: Independent IT contractors, consultants, engineers, doctors, architects, and freelancers wanting direct personal cash access.

entities.name: PFA — Normă de Venit (Fixed Income Norm)
entities.summary: 10% Income Tax + CAS/CASS calculated on a fixed county-level 'Income Norm' (typically 40,000–65,000 RON/yr) rather than actual revenue, up to the €25,000 annual gross ceiling.
entities.bestFor: Eligible service/craft CAEN codes earning under €25,000/yr seeking ultra-simple single-entry bookkeeping.

entities.name: II / IF (Întreprindere Individuală / Familială)
entities.summary: Taxed identically to PFA (10% net income tax + capped CAS 25% and CASS 10%), while permitting broader CAEN combinations, hiring employees, or pooling family members under an IF agreement.
entities.bestFor: Family-operated businesses, local merchants, and rural/artisan enterprises.

entities.name: SRL Microîntreprindere (1% Turnover Tier)
entities.summary: 1% tax on Gross Turnover + 10% Dividend Tax (+ capped CASS on dividends) + mandatory 1 full-time employee (CIM minimum wage taxes ~1,650 RON/mo). Full Limited Liability shield.
entities.bestFor: Small commercial, e-commerce, production, or non-IT startups under €60,000 revenue with high margins.

entities.name: SRL Microîntreprindere (3% Turnover Tier)
entities.turnoverCap: Up to Micro ceiling (€250k → €100k phased cap; requires ≥ 1 employee)
entities.summary: 3% tax on Gross Turnover (applies if turnover > €60,000 OR for IT software CAEN 6201/6202, HoReCa, legal & medical codes) + 10% Dividend Tax + capped CASS.
entities.bestFor: Software agencies, IT studios, HoReCa, and high-margin service companies below the Micro turnover cap.

entities.name: SRL Impozit pe Profit (Standard 16% LLC)
entities.summary: 16% Corporate Income Tax on Net Profit (Revenue − Deductible Expenses, salaries, equipment, R&D) + 10% Dividend Tax on distributed profit (+ capped CASS). Mandatory above Micro ceiling.
entities.bestFor: Management consultants, scaling companies above the Micro cap, and businesses with significant operating costs.

entities.name: SA (Societate pe Acțiuni — Joint-Stock Corp)
entities.summary: 16% Corporate Profit Tax (plus 1% Minimum Turnover Tax 'IMCA' if turnover > €50M; 0% dividend tax for holding companies owning ≥10% for ≥1 year).
entities.bestFor: Large industrial enterprises, banks, insurers, and Bucharest Stock Exchange (BVB) issuers.

USA.taxAuthority: IRS (Internal Revenue Service) + 50 State Revenue Departments
USA.pitSystem: 7 Federal Brackets (10%, 12%, 22%, 24%, 32%, 35%, 37%) + Standard Deduction ($15,000 single / $30,000 married)
USA.employeeSocialBreakdown: FICA: 6.2% Social Security (up to $176,100 wage base) + 1.45% Medicare (+0.9% Additional Medicare >$200k)
USA.employerPayrollBreakdown: 7.65% Employer FICA match + FUTA (0.6%) & State Unemployment (SUTA)
USA.vatReduced: 0% Federal VAT • 0% – 10.25% State & Local Retail Sales Tax (0% in OR, NH, MT, DE, AK)
USA.dividendNotes: 0%, 15%, or 20% Qualified Dividend Rate + 3.8% Net Investment Income Tax (NIIT) for high earners
USA.capitalGainsRate: 0%, 15%, or 20% Long-Term Capital Gains (>1 yr) + 3.8% NIIT; Section 1202 QSBS allows 0% tax on up to $10M C-Corp startup exit

entities.name: Sole Proprietorship / 1099 Independent Contractor
entities.summary: 0% entity-level tax. Net business income is taxed at Federal PIT (10%–37%) + 15.3% Self-Employment Tax (Social Security & Medicare), reduced by the 20% QBI Deduction (Section 199A) and Solo 401(k) deductions.
entities.bestFor: Solo freelancers, side-hustles, and independent contractors starting with zero formation paperwork.

entities.name: LLC (Single-Member or Multi-Member Partnership)
entities.summary: Full corporate liability shield while defaulting to pass-through taxation (Schedule C or Form 1065 K-1) with 20% QBI deduction. Foreign-owned single-member Disregarded LLCs with no US ETBUS pay 0% US federal tax (Form 5472).
entities.bestFor: Real estate holdings, agencies, e-commerce brands, and international digital founders.

entities.name: S-Corporation (LLC or Corp with Form 2553 Election)
entities.summary: Pass-through entity splitting profit into a 'Reasonable W-2 Salary' (subject to 15.3% FICA payroll tax) and 'Shareholder Distributions' (100% exempt from the 15.3% Self-Employment Tax!) + 20% QBI deduction.
entities.bestFor: Profitable US consultants, doctors, agencies, and small business owners earning $80,000–$500,000/yr net profit.

entities.name: C-Corporation (Delaware C-Corp / Form 1120)
entities.summary: 21% Flat Federal Corporate Income Tax (+ ~4%–8.8% state CIT where applicable). Eligible for Section 1202 QSBS (0% federal capital gains tax on up to $10M or 10× basis after 5 years!).
entities.bestFor: Venture-backed tech startups, Y Combinator companies, foreign parent subsidiaries, and IPO candidates.

entities.name: LLP / LP (Limited Liability / Limited Partnership)
entities.summary: Pass-through partnership separating General Partners (GP) and Limited Partners (LP), enabling carried interest and capital gains pass-through.
entities.bestFor: Venture capital funds, private equity funds, law firms, and accounting practices.

GBR.employeeSocialBreakdown: Class 1 Employee National Insurance (NIC): 8% (£12,570–£50,270) and 2% above £50,270
GBR.employerPayrollBreakdown: 15% Employer Class 1 National Insurance above £5,000 secondary threshold
GBR.vatReduced: 5% (domestic energy, child car seats) • 0% (most food, books, children's clothing)
GBR.dividendNotes: £500 tax-free allowance, then 8.75% (Basic rate), 33.75% (Higher rate), 39.35% (Additional rate)
GBR.capitalGainsRate: 18% / 24% Standard CGT; 14% Business Asset Disposal Relief (up to £1M lifetime limit)
GBR.propertyTax: Council Tax + Stamp Duty Land Tax (SDLT 0%–12%)

entities.name: Sole Trader (Self-Employed)
entities.summary: Taxed via Self-Assessment at UK Income Tax rates (20%/40%/45% after £12,570 allowance) + Class 4 National Insurance (6% up to £50,270, 2% above).
entities.bestFor: Solo tradespeople, writers, and contractors earning under £50,000/yr.

entities.name: Private Limited Company (Ltd — 19% Small Profits)
entities.summary: 19% Corporation Tax on profits up to £50,000 (tapering to 25% at £250,000). Owners combine a £12,570 tax-free director salary + low-tax dividends (8.75% basic band) + up to £60,000 tax-free employer SIPP pension.
entities.bestFor: Contractors, agencies, and SMEs optimizing salary + dividend + SIPP pension extraction.

entities.name: LLP (Limited Liability Partnership)
entities.summary: Corporate limited liability with tax transparency—profits pass directly to members without 25% Corporation Tax or 15% Employer NIC!
entities.bestFor: Law firms, hedge funds, architecture practices, and professional partnerships.

entities.name: Ltd / PLC (Main 25% Corporation Rate)
entities.summary: 25% Main Corporation Tax rate with 100% Full Expensing on qualifying plant/machinery, R&D Tax Relief, SEIS/EIS investor reliefs, and 10% Patent Box rate.
entities.bestFor: Medium/large enterprises, angel-backed startups, and London-listed PLCs.

DEU.employeeSocialBreakdown: ~20.6% Employee share (Pension 9.3%, Health ~8.15%, Unemployment 1.3%, Care 1.8% up to contribution ceilings)
DEU.employerPayrollBreakdown: ~20.6% Employer 50/50 parity contribution to statutory social insurance
DEU.vatReduced: 7% (food, books, public transport, cultural events, hotel stays)
DEU.dividendNotes: 25% Abgeltungsteuer + 5.5% Solidaritätszuschlag = 26.375% flat withholding tax (€1,000 exempt)
DEU.capitalGainsRate: 26.375% on stocks/ETFs; 0% on Gold & Crypto held > 1 year (private sale § 23 EStG); 0% on Real Estate held > 10 years!

entities.name: Freiberufler (Liberal Professions — § 18 EStG)
entities.turnoverCap: Unlimited for catalog professions (IT, Engineers, Doctors, Lawyers, Designers)
entities.summary: 100% exempt from Gewerbesteuer (municipal trade tax) and IHK chamber fees! Simple EÜR cash accounting; taxed solely at personal progressive rates.
entities.bestFor: Software engineers, IT consultants, architects, physicians, journalists, and artists.

entities.name: Einzelunternehmen / Kleinunternehmer (§ 19 UStG)
entities.turnoverCap: VAT exempt if prior year ≤ €25,000 (current year ≤ €100,000)
entities.summary: Commercial sole proprietorship. First €24,500 of profit is exempt from Gewerbesteuer (Trade Tax), and Trade Tax paid is credited against personal income tax.
entities.bestFor: E-commerce sellers, retail shops, and commercial trades.

entities.name: UG (haftungsbeschränkt) & GmbH (Limited Liability)
entities.turnoverCap: UG: €1 min capital • GmbH: €25,000 min capital (€12,500 paid-in)
entities.summary: 15% Körperschaftsteuer + 0.825% Soli + ~14% municipal Gewerbesteuer = ~29.9% corporate rate. Holding GmbHs pay only ~1.54% tax on dividends/exits from subsidiary GmbHs (§ 8b KStG)!
entities.bestFor: Operating SMEs, venture startups, and Holding GmbH wealth structures.

entities.name: AG (Aktiengesellschaft — German Stock Corporation)
entities.summary: ~29.9% combined corporate & trade tax (varies from ~22.8% in low-multiplier municipalities like Grünwald to ~32% in Munich/Berlin).
entities.bestFor: DAX/MDAX listed corporations and large industrial groups.

FRA.taxAuthority: DGFiP (Direction Générale des Finances Publiques / impots.gouv.fr)
FRA.employerPayrollBreakdown: 25% – 45% Employer social charges (reduced via Fillon relief on lower wages)
FRA.dividendNotes: 30% Flat Tax (PFU — Prélèvement Forfaitaire Unique: 12.8% income tax + 17.2% social levies)
FRA.capitalGainsRate: 30% PFU Flat Tax on stocks, dividends, and crypto-to-fiat conversions (0% on crypto-to-crypto)
FRA.propertyTax: Taxe Foncière + IFI (Real Estate Wealth Tax above €1.3M net property)

entities.name: Micro-Entrepreneur (Auto-Entrepreneur)
entities.summary: Pay a single flat percentage on collected turnover (~12.3% for commerce, ~21.1%–23.1% for services/liberal professions + optional 1%–2.2% Versement Libératoire income tax). Zero tax if turnover is €0.
entities.bestFor: Freelancers, consultants, designers, and solo creators up to €77,700/yr.

entities.name: SASU / EURL (Reduced 15% PME Corporate Tier)
entities.summary: 15% reduced Corporate Tax (IS) on the first €42,500 of net profit, then 25% standard IS above. SASU dividends enjoy the 30% PFU Flat Tax without SSI self-employment social charges.
entities.bestFor: Solo founders, tech consultants (ACRE 1st-year relief), and scalable startups.

entities.name: SAS / SARL / SA (Standard 25% Société)
entities.summary: 25% Corporate Tax (Impôt sur les Sociétés) + Crédit d'Impôt Recherche (CIR: 30% R&D tax credit up to €100M R&D spend) + JEI Young Innovative Enterprise exemptions.
entities.bestFor: Deep-tech R&D companies, SMEs, and corporate groups.

ITA.vatReduced: 10% (restaurants, hotels, renovation) • 5% (herbs, social services) • 4% (staple foods, books)
ITA.dividendNotes: 26% Flat Substitute Tax (Imposta Sostitutiva) on dividends and interest
ITA.capitalGainsRate: 26% Flat Tax on equities & bonds (12.5% on Italian/white-list government bonds BTP)
ITA.propertyTax: IMU (0.4% – 1.06% on second homes/commercial; 0% on non-luxury primary residence!)

entities.name: Partita IVA — Regime Forfettario (5% / 15% Flat!)
entities.summary: 5% Flat Tax for the first 5 years of a new business (15% thereafter) applied to a statutory profitability coefficient (e.g. 67%–78% of revenue) + INPS social contributions! 100% VAT-exempt invoicing!
entities.bestFor: Freelancers, software developers, consultants, and digital professionals earning up to €85,000/yr.

entities.name: S.r.l. / S.r.l.s. (Società a Responsabilità Limitata)
entities.summary: 24% IRES corporate income tax + ~3.9% regional IRAP tax. Innovative Startups (Startup Innovativa) enjoy tax credits and simplified equity crowdfunding.
entities.bestFor: Italian SMEs, manufacturing firms, and venture-backed startups.

entities.name: S.p.A. (Società per Azioni — Joint-Stock Corp)
entities.summary: 24% IRES + 3.9% IRAP with 95% PEX (Participation Exemption: only 1.2% effective tax on subsidiary dividends/capital gains for holding S.p.A./S.r.l.!).
entities.bestFor: Industrial groups, holding structures, and Borsa Italiana listed enterprises.

ESP.pitHeadline: 19% – 47% Progressive IRPF (or 24% Beckham Law Flat Expat Tax)
ESP.pitSystem: Progressive Federal + Autonomous Community IRPF (lower in Madrid/Andalusia; Beckham Law 24% flat up to €600k)
ESP.employerPayrollBreakdown: ~30.5% Employer Seguridad Social contribution (capped at €4,909/mo base)
ESP.vatReduced: 10% (hospitality, transport, housing) • 4% (basic food, books, medicine) • 7% IGIC in Canary Islands!
ESP.capitalGainsRate: 19% – 28% Savings Income Tax Brackets (Base del Ahorro)

entities.name: Autónomo (Self-Employed Professional)
entities.summary: €80/month Tarifa Plana social fee in Year 1 (then €200–€590/mo income-tiered Cuota de Autónomos) + progressive IRPF income tax with 7% general expense allowance.
entities.bestFor: Independent contractors, remote workers, and local service providers.

entities.name: S.L. — Startup & Micro-SME (Ley de Startups 15% / 21%)
entities.turnoverCap: €1–€3,000 share capital; 15% rate for first 2 profitable years (up to 4 yrs under Startup Act)
entities.summary: 15% Corporate Tax (Impuesto sobre Sociedades) for newly formed Spanish S.L. companies in their first profitable years, or 20%–23% reduced micro-SME tier (4% ZEC rate in Canary Islands!).
entities.bestFor: Tech startups, Canary Islands ZEC companies, and growing agencies.

entities.name: S.L. / S.A. (Standard 25% Sociedad Limitada / Anónima)
entities.summary: 25% Standard Corporate Income Tax with 95% participation exemption for Spanish ETVE holding companies.
entities.bestFor: Established corporations, real estate, and LATAM-Europe ETVE holding companies.

POL.pitSystem: 0% up to 30,000 PLN allowance; 12% up to 120,000 PLN; 32% above (0% PIT up to 85,528 PLN for workers under 26!)
POL.employeeSocialBreakdown: 13.71% ZUS Social Security + 9% NFZ Health Insurance
POL.dividendNotes: 19% Flat Belka Tax on dividends and investment income
POL.capitalGainsRate: 19% Flat Belka Tax on stocks, ETFs, and crypto-to-fiat conversions
POL.propertyTax: Low fixed PLN per m² municipal building/land rate

entities.name: JDG — Ryczałt (B2B Lump-Sum Turnover Tax: 8.5% / 12% IT)
entities.summary: Famous Polish B2B Contractor regime: 12% flat tax on IT/software revenue (8.5% for general/PM services, 14% architects/engineers, 3% commerce) + fixed capped ZUS & fixed-tier health fee! 0% dividend tax.
entities.bestFor: Software engineers, DevOps, product managers, and B2B tech contractors.

entities.name: JDG — 19% Linear Tax & 5% IP Box
entities.summary: 19% Flat Linear Tax on net profit (+ 4.9% health contribution), dropping to just 5% Income Tax on qualifying R&D / copyrighted software code under the Polish IP Box!
entities.bestFor: R&D software creators and high-expense sole proprietors.

entities.name: Sp. z o.o. — Mały Podatnik (9% Small CIT & Estonian CIT)
entities.summary: 9% Corporate Income Tax for companies under €2M revenue! Furthermore, opting into 'Polish Estonian CIT' gives 0% tax on retained profits and only ~20% combined effective tax upon dividend payout!
entities.bestFor: Software houses, e-commerce brands, and SMEs scaling up to €2M.

entities.name: Sp. z o.o. / S.A. (Standard 19% Corporate)
entities.summary: 19% Standard CIT (or 0% retained / ~25% distributed under Large Estonian CIT) + 200% R&D super-deduction.
entities.bestFor: Mid-market and enterprise corporations.

HUN.pitHeadline: 15% Flat Personal Income Tax (0% for Mothers of 3+ & Under-25s)
HUN.pitSystem: 15% Flat SZJA Rate (0% lifetime PIT exemption for mothers with 3+ children & youth under 25 up to average wage)
HUN.vatReduced: 18% (dairy, bakery) • 5% (meat, milk, eggs, books, medicines, new housing, restaurant dining)
HUN.dividendNotes: 15% Dividend Tax + 13% Szocho (Szocho is CAPPED once total annual income/dividends hit 24× minimum wage!)
HUN.capitalGainsRate: 15% Flat Capital Gains & Crypto Tax (0% after 5 years inside a TBSZ Long-Term Investment Account!)
HUN.propertyTax: Low municipal building tax + 4% transfer duty on purchase

entities.name: Átalányadózó Egyéni Vállalkozó & KATA (Flat Sole Trader)
entities.turnoverCap: Átalányadó up to ~32M HUF; KATA 50,000 HUF/mo fixed for B2C
entities.summary: KATA charges a flat 50,000 HUF (~€125/mo) for B2C freelancers up to 18M HUF; Átalányadó grants a 40%, 80%, or 90% automatic expense deduction for B2B contractors before 15% PIT.
entities.bestFor: Solo B2C service providers (KATA) and B2B freelancers (Átalányadó).

entities.name: Kft. (Korlátolt Felelősségű Társaság — 9% CIT LLC)
entities.summary: 9% Flat Corporate Income Tax—the lowest statutory CIT in the European Union! (+ 0%–2% municipal HIPA business tax + 15% dividend tax with capped Szocho).
entities.bestFor: Central European trading hubs, manufacturing, and EU holding/operating companies.

entities.name: Zrt. / Nyrt. (Private / Public Joint-Stock Corp)
entities.summary: 9% Corporate Tax + 0% withholding tax on outbound dividends, interest, and royalties paid to foreign corporate parents!
entities.bestFor: International corporate subsidiaries and industrial plants.

NLD.pitSystem: Box 1 Employment/Business (35.82%–49.5%), Box 2 Substantial Interest (24.5%–31%), Box 3 Wealth/Savings (+ 30%/27% Expat Ruling)
NLD.employeeSocialBreakdown: 27.65% National Insurance (integrated into the first €38,441 Box 1 bracket)
NLD.employerPayrollBreakdown: ~18% – 22% Employer ZVW health & employee insurance levies
NLD.dividendNotes: Box 2 Substantial Shareholder (≥5%): 24.5% up to €67,804 (€135,608 for couples), 31% above
NLD.capitalGainsRate: 0% actual realized capital gains tax in Box 3 (taxed on deemed/actual return yield above €57,684 tax-free wealth)

entities.name: ZZP / Eenmanszaak (Dutch Sole Proprietor)
entities.summary: Qualifying entrepreneurs (>1,225 hrs/yr) receive Zelfstandigenaftrek + Startersaftrek + 12.7% MKB-winstvrijstelling profit exemption before Box 1 tax.
entities.bestFor: Dutch independent freelancers (ZZP'ers) and consultants.

entities.name: B.V. — Besloten Vennootschap (19% SME Tier & 9% Innovation Box)
entities.summary: 19% Corporate Tax (VPB) on the first €200,000 of profit (25.8% above) + 9% Innovation Box rate on R&D/WBSO profits!
entities.bestFor: Tech startups, SMEs, and innovation-driven companies.

entities.name: Dutch Holding B.V. & N.V. (25.8% Main CIT + 0% Participation Exemption)
entities.summary: 25.8% Main Corporate Tax (>€200k), famous worldwide for the Deelnemingsvrijstelling (100% tax-free dividends and 0% capital gains when a Dutch Holding B.V. sells ≥5% subsidiary shares!).
entities.bestFor: Double-B.V. founder holding structures, multinationals, and Euronext Amsterdam N.V.s.

IRL.pitSystem: 20% Standard Rate + 40% Higher Rate + Universal Social Charge (USC 0.5%–8%) + Tax Credits
IRL.vatReduced: 13.5% (hospitality, energy, construction) • 9% (newspapers, sports) • 0% (food, books, children's clothes)
IRL.dividendNotes: Taxed at marginal income tax (25% DWT withholding; 0% for treaty residents & non-domiciled foreign dividends)
IRL.capitalGainsRate: 33% Standard CGT; 10% Revised Entrepreneur Relief on up to €1M lifetime business exit!

entities.name: Irish Sole Trader
entities.summary: Taxed at 20%/40% Income Tax + 4.1% Class S PRSI + USC (+ €1,950 Earned Income Tax Credit).
entities.bestFor: Solo professionals and local trades.

entities.name: LTD — Private Company Limited by Shares (12.5% Trading CIT!)
entities.turnoverCap: €1 min capital (0% CIT for 3 yrs under Startup Relief up to €40k CT!)
entities.summary: World-famous 12.5% Corporate Tax on active trading profits + 30% R&D Tax Credit + 6.25% Knowledge Development Box (IP) + generous Executive Pension extraction!
entities.bestFor: European SaaS/tech headquarters, startups, and international service companies.

entities.name: PLC / Large Multinational Group (>€750M Revenue)
entities.summary: 15% OECD Pillar Two Minimum Effective Tax for multinationals above €750M (while all SMEs under €750M keep the 12.5% rate!).
entities.bestFor: Global tech, pharma, and aircraft-leasing multinationals.

CYP.pitSystem: 0% up to €19,500; 20%–35% above (50% PIT exemption for 17 years on new residents earning ≥€55,000/yr!)
CYP.vatReduced: 9% (restaurants, hotels, taxis) • 5% (food, books, medicines, first 130m² home)
CYP.dividendNotes: 0% Dividend Tax (+ just 2.65% GESY health capped at €180k) for Cyprus Non-Dom residents for 17 years! (17% SDC for domiciled locals)
CYP.capitalGainsRate: 0% Tax on Profits from Sale of Shares, Bonds, ETFs & Securities!

entities.name: Self-Employed Professional
entities.summary: First €19,500 completely tax-free, progressive 20%–35% above + capped Social Insurance.
entities.bestFor: Local sole practitioners.

entities.name: Cyprus LTD — Non-Dom & 2.5% IP Box Company
entities.summary: 12.5% Corporate Tax (or just 2.5% effective CIT on qualifying software/IP under the 80% Cyprus IP Box!) + 0% Dividend Tax for Non-Dom founders (+ 2.65% capped GESY)!
entities.bestFor: EU software companies, SaaS founders, and digital entrepreneurs.

entities.name: Cyprus International Holding LTD / PLC
entities.summary: 0% tax on incoming dividends from foreign subsidiaries, 0% tax on sale of shares/equities, 0% outbound dividend WHT, and Notional Interest Deduction (NID) reducing taxable CIT by up to 80%!
entities.bestFor: European M&A holding companies, investment funds, and shipping groups.

MDA.taxAuthority: SFS (Serviciul Fiscal de Stat — Republic of Moldova)
MDA.pitSystem: 12% Flat Rate with personal annual exemptions
MDA.employeeSocialBreakdown: 9% Compulsory Health Insurance (CNAM; pension paid by employer)
MDA.capitalGainsRate: 6% Effective Personal Capital Gains Rate (12% tax applied to only 50% of net capital gain!)

entities.name: SRL — Moldova IT Park Resident (7% Single Tax!)
entities.turnoverCap: Guaranteed by law through 2035 (70%+ IT/design/R&D/BPO revenue)
entities.summary: 7% Single Turnover Tax that completely replaces Corporate Income Tax, Employee Salary PIT, Employer/Employee Social & Health taxes, and local taxes! Plus 0%–6% dividend extraction.
entities.bestFor: Software engineering studios, SaaS startups, game studios, and BPO exporters.

entities.name: SRL — Întreprindere Mică/Mijlocie (4% Turnover SME)
entities.turnoverCap: Non-VAT registered SMEs up to 1.2M MDL
entities.summary: 4% simplified tax on operational revenue for non-VAT micro/small companies + 6% dividend tax.
entities.bestFor: Small domestic services, retail, and local startups.

entities.name: SRL / SA — Standard Corporate (12% CIT + 0% Retained SME)
entities.turnoverCap: Unlimited (0% CIT on undistributed SME profits!)
entities.summary: 12% Corporate Profit Tax (with 0% deferral option for qualifying SMEs until profit is distributed!) + 6% Dividend Tax = 17.28% total combined tax.
entities.bestFor: Commercial, agricultural, winemaking, and industrial enterprises.

ARE.taxAuthority: FTA (Federal Tax Authority — United Arab Emirates)
ARE.pitHeadline: 0% Personal Income Tax • 0% Capital Gains • 0% Dividend Tax
ARE.pitSystem: 0% Personal Income Tax for residents and expatriates
ARE.employeeSocialBreakdown: 0% for Expatriates (5% GPSSA pension only for UAE/GCC nationals)
ARE.employerPayrollBreakdown: 0% Payroll Tax for Expatriates (mandatory health insurance + End-of-Service Gratuity accrual)
ARE.vatReduced: 0% (exports, international transport, healthcare, education, residential leases)
ARE.dividendNotes: 0% Withholding Tax on Dividends, Interest, and Royalties
ARE.capitalGainsRate: 0% Personal Capital Gains, Crypto, and Equity Tax
ARE.propertyTax: 0% annual property tax (4% Dubai Land Department transfer fee on purchase)

entities.name: UAE Freelance Permit & Golden Visa Professional
entities.turnoverCap: 0% Corporate Tax if business turnover ≤ AED 1,000,000 (~$272,000/yr)
entities.summary: Natural persons conducting freelance/business activities in the UAE pay 0% tax if annual business turnover is below AED 1M (~$272k), and 0% on employment salaries or personal investments.
entities.bestFor: Digital nomads, remote executives, creators, and solo consultants.

entities.name: UAE LLC / Free Zone — Small Business Relief (SBR)
entities.summary: 0% Corporate Tax under UAE Small Business Relief for resident entities with revenue ≤ AED 3M, plus 0% tax on the first AED 375,000 (~$102,000) of net profit for all companies!
entities.bestFor: SMEs, e-commerce, trading, and international agencies under $816k revenue.

entities.name: UAE Mainland LLC / Qualifying Free Zone Person (QFZP)
entities.summary: 0% on Qualifying Free Zone income (or first AED 375,000 profit), and 9% Corporate Tax on profits above AED 375,000 (~$102,000). 0% dividend withholding.
entities.bestFor: Global headquarters, family offices, fintechs (DIFC/ADGM), and international trade hubs.

CHE.taxAuthority: ESTV / AFC (Federal Tax Administration + 26 Cantonal Tax Offices)
CHE.pitHeadline: 11.5% Max Federal + Cantonal (Combined ~22% in Zug to ~41% in Geneva)
CHE.employeeSocialBreakdown: 5.3% AHV/IV/EO (1st Pillar) + 1.1% ALV Unemployment + 2nd Pillar BVG pension
